baseline: F1 cup and airfoil parameter set, uncalibrated installed layout
next_separate_factors: tip clearance after hot-clearance and centrifugal review
inlet lip and elbow guide vanes
plenum taper and branch area balance
forward/backward sweep at unchanged section geometry
comparison_rules: Same inlet density and complete system pressure boundary conditions.
Report both same RPM and matched shaft power; do not rank by flow alone.
Track minimum of six branch mass flows, distribution coefficient of variation, core pressure drop, shaft torque, and charge/engine temperatures.
Keep reference geometry, solver revision, native fields, residuals and port histories for every case.
Reject mesh topology/geometry failures; do not relax acceptance thresholds to declare a winner.

cfd_acceptance.mesh_independence: at least three resolutions with relevant port-flow/pressure sensitivity

physical_bench: Guarded fixed-speed rig with independent shaft speed and torque measurement.
Calibrated inlet flow device and static/total pressure taps before and after the core and fan.
Six independently measured engine outlets or calibrated branch resistances.
Charge-air mass flow, inlet/outlet temperatures and pressures; ambient temperature and density.
Repeated baseline/variant/baseline runs; record instrument uncertainty and thermal equilibrium.
